in a maze faster in the light than in the dark. If an animal does not find the food after 10 minutes,
they are given the food by the experimenter.

text: Dr Clare is planning an observational study of student behaviour in a library at a university. She
will be the only observer. She is interested in student behaviours such as:
• how they study
• how they find books
• what they do in the library other than studying
• how long they spend in the library.
